L00034: L00035: ## 💥 Impact L00036: BigCodeBench has been trusted by many LLM teams including: L00037: - Zhipu AI L00038: - Alibaba Qwen L00039: - DeepSeek L00040: - Amazon AWS AI L00041: - Snowflake AI Research L00042: - ServiceNow Research L00043: - Meta AI L00044: - Cohere AI L00045: - Sakana AI L00046: - Allen Institute for Artificial Intelligence (AI2) L00047: L00048: ## 📰 News L00049: - **[2025-01-22]** We are releasing `bigcodebench==v0.2.2.dev2`, with 163 models evaluated! L00050: - **[2024-10-06]** We are releasing `bigcodebench==v0.2.0`! It can be viewed [here](https://huggingface.co/spaces/bigcode/bigcodebench-leaderboard). L00054: - **[2024-08-02]** We release `bigcodebench==v0.1.9`. L00055: L00056:

The details are available [in this blog post](https://huggingface.co/blog/terryyz/bigcodebench-hard). The dataset is available [here](https://huggingface.co/datasets/bigcode/bigcodebench-hard). The new release is `bigcodebench==v0.1.8`. L00060: - **[2024-06-28]** We release `bigcodebench==v0.1.7`. L00061: - **[2024-06-27]** We release `bigcodebench==v0.1.6`. L00062: - **[2024-06-19]** We start the Hugging Face BigCodeBench Leaderboard! The leaderboard is available [here](https://huggingface.co/spaces/bigcode/bigcodebench-leaderboard). L00063: - **[2024-06-18]** We release BigCodeBench, a new benchmark for code generation with 1140 software-engineering-oriented programming tasks. Preprint is available [here](https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.15877). PyPI package is available [here](https://pypi.org/project/bigcodebench/) with the version `0.1.5`. L00064: L00065:
L00066:
L00067: L00068: ## 🌸 About L00069: L00070: ### BigCodeBench L00071: L00072: BigCodeBench is an **_easy-to-use_** benchmark for solving **_practical_** and **_challenging_** tasks via code. It aims to evaluate the true programming capabilities of large language models (LLMs) in a more realistic setting. The benchmark is designed for HumanEval-like function-level code generation tasks, but with much more complex instructions and diverse function calls. L00073: L00074: There are two splits in BigCodeBench: L00075: - `Complete`: Thes split is designed for code completion based on the comprehensive docstrings. L00076: - `Instruct`: The split works for the instruction-tuned and chat models only, where the models are asked to generate a code snippet based on the natural language instructions. The instructions only contain necessary information, and require more complex reasoning. L00077: L00078: ### Why BigCodeBench? L00079: L00080: BigCodeBench focuses on task automation via code generation with *diverse function calls* and *complex instructions*, with: L00081: L00082: * ✨ **Precise evaluation & ranking**: See [our leaderboard](https://huggingface.co/spaces/bigcode/bigcodebench-leaderboard) for latest LLM rankings before & after rigorous evaluation. L00083: * ✨ **Pre-generated samples**: BigCodeBench accelerates code intelligence research by open-sourcing [LLM-generated samples](#-LLM-generated-code) for various models -- no need to re-run the expensive benchmarks! L00084: L00085: ## 🔥 Quick Start L00086: L00087: To get started, please first set up the environment: L00088: L00089: ```bash L00090: # By default, you will use the remote evaluation API to execute the output samples. L00091: pip install bigcodebench --upgrade L00092: L00093: # You are suggested to use `flash-attn` for generating code samples. L00094: pip install packaging ninja L00095: pip install flash-attn --no-build-isolation L00096: # Note: if you have installation problem, consider using pre-built L00097: # wheels from https://github.com/Dao-AILab/flash-attention/releases L00098: ``` L00099: L00100:
⏬ Install nightly version :: click to expand :: L00101:
L00102: L00103: ```bash L00104: # Install to use bigcodebench.generate L00105: pip install "git+https://github.com/bigcode-project/bigcodebench.git" --upgrade L00106: ``` L00107: L00108:
L00109:
L00110: L00111: L00112: ## 🚀 Remote Evaluation L00113: L00114: We use the greedy decoding as an example to show how to evaluate the generated code samples via remote API. L00115: > [!Warning] L00116: > L00117: > To ease the generation, we use batch inference by default. However, the batch inference results could vary from *batch sizes to batch sizes* and *versions to versions*, at least for the vLLM backend. If you want to get more deterministic results for greedy decoding, please set `--bs` to `1`. L00118: L00119: > [!Note] L00120: > L00121: > `gradio` backend on `BigCodeBench-Full` typically takes 6-7 minutes, and on `BigCodeBench-Hard` typically takes 4-5 minutes. L00122: > `e2b` backend with default machine on `BigCodeBench-Full` typically takes 25-30 minutes, and on `BigCodeBench-Hard` typically takes 15-20 minutes. L00123: L00124: ```bash L00125: bigcodebench.evaluate \ L00126: --model meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct \ L00127: --execution [e2b|gradio|local] \ L00128: --split [complete|instruct] \ L00129: --subset [full|hard] \ L00130: --backend [vllm|openai|anthropic|google|mistral|hf|hf-inference] L00131: ``` L00132: L00133: - All the resulted files will be stored in a folder named `bcb_results`. L00134: - The generated code samples will be stored in a file named `[model_name]--bigcodebench-[instruct|complete]--[backend]-[temp]-[n_samples]-sanitized_calibrated.jsonl`. L00135: - The evaluation results will be stored in a file named `[model_name]--bigcodebench-[instruct|complete]--[backend]-[temp]-[n_samples]-sanitized_calibrated_eval_results.json`. L00136: - The pass@k results will be stored in a file named `[model_name]--bigcodebench-[instruct|complete]--[backend]-[temp]-[n_samples]-sanitized_calibrated_pass_at_k.json`. L00137: L00138: > [!Note] L00139: > L00140: > The `gradio` backend is hosted on the [Hugging Face space](https://huggingface.co/spaces/bigcode/bigcodebench-evaluator) by default. L00141: > The default space can be sometimes slow, so we recommend you to use the `gradio` backend with a cloned [bigcodebench-evaluator](https://huggingface.co/spaces/bigcode/bigcodebench-evaluator) endpoint for faster evaluation. L00142: > Otherwise, you can also use the `e2b` sandbox for evaluation, which is also pretty slow on the default machine. L00143: L00144: > [!Note] L00145: > L00146: > BigCodeBench uses different prompts for base and chat models. L00147: > By default it is detected by `tokenizer.chat_template` when using `hf`/`vllm` as backend. L00148: > For other backends, only chat mode is allowed. L00149: > L00150: > Therefore, if your base models come with a `tokenizer.chat_template`, L00151: > please add `--direct_completion` to avoid being evaluated L00152: > in a chat mode. L00153: L00154: To use E2B, you need to set up an account and get an API key from [E2B](https://e2b.dev/). L00155: L00156: ```bash L00157: export E2B_API_KEY= L00158: ``` L00159: L00160: Access OpenAI APIs from [OpenAI Console](https://platform.openai.com/) L00161: ```bash L00162: export OPENAI_API_KEY= L00163: ``` L00164: L00165: Access Anthropic APIs from [Anthropic Console](https://console.anthropic.com/) L00166: ```bash L00167: export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY= L00168: ``` L00169: L00170: Access Mistral APIs from [Mistral Console](https://console.mistral.ai/) L00171: ```bash L00172: export MISTRAL_API_KEY= L00173: ``` L00174: L00175: Access Gemini APIs from [Google AI Studio](https://aistudio.google.com/) L00176: ```bash L00177: export GOOGLE_API_KEY= L00178: ``` L00179: L00180: Access the [Hugging Face Serverless Inference API](https://huggingface.co/docs/api-inference/en/index) L00181: ```bash L00182: export HF_INFERENCE_API_KEY= L00183: ``` L00184: L00185: Please make sure your HF access token has the `Make calls to inference providers` permission. L00186: L00187: ## 💻 LLM-generated Code L00188: L00189: We share pre-generated code samples from LLMs we have [evaluated](https://huggingface.co/spaces/bigcode/bigcodebench-leaderboard) on the full set: L00190: * See the attachment of our [v0.2.4](https://github.com/bigcode-project/bigcodebench/releases/tag/v0.2.4). We include `sanitized_samples_calibrated.zip` for your convenience. L00191: L00192: ## 🧑 Advanced Usage L00193: L00194: Please refer to the [ADVANCED USAGE](https://github.com/bigcode-project/bigcodebench/blob/main/ADVANCED_USAGE.md) for more details. L00195: L00196: ## 📰 Result Submission L00197: L00198: Please email both the generated code samples and the execution results to [terry.zhuo@monash.edu](mailto:terry.zhuo@monash.edu) if you would like to contribute your model to the leaderboard. Note that the file names should be in the format of `[model_name]--[revision]--[bigcodebench|bigcodebench-hard]-[instruct|complete]--[backend]-[temp]-[n_samples]-sanitized_calibrated.jsonl` and `[model_name]--[revision]--[bigcodebench|bigcodebench-hard]-[instruct|complete]--[backend]-[temp]-[n_samples]-sanitized_calibrated_eval_results.json`. You can [file an issue](https://github.com/bigcode-project/bigcodebench/issues/new/choose) to remind us if we do not respond to your email within 3 days. L00199: L00200: ## 📜 Citation L00201: L00202: ```bibtex L00203: @article{zhuo2024bigcodebench, L00204: title={BigCodeBench: Benchmarking Code Generation with Diverse Function Calls and Complex Instructions}, L00205: author={Zhuo, Terry Yue and Vu, Minh Chien and Chim, Jenny and Hu, Han and Yu, Wenhao and Widyasari, Ratnadira and Yusuf, Imam Nur Bani and Zhan, Haolan and He, Junda and Paul, Indraneil and others}, L00206: journal={arXiv preprint arXiv:2406.15877}, L00207: year={2024} L00208: } L00209: ``` L00210: L00211: ## 🙏 Acknowledgement L00212: L00213: - [EvalPlus](https://github.com/evalplus/evalplus)

L00042: def get_groundtruth(n_workers, problems, hashcode, check_gt_only, max_as_limit, max_data_limit, max_stack_limit, min_time_limit):
L00043:     cache_file = os.path.join(CACHE_DIR, f"{hashcode}.pkl")
L00044:     if os.path.exists(cache_file):
L00045:         if check_gt_only:
L00046:             os.remove(cache_file)
L00047:         else:
L00048:             print(f"Load from ground-truth from {cache_file}")
L00049:             with open(cache_file, "rb") as f:
L00050:                 return pickle.load(f)
L00051: 
L00052:     os.makedirs(CACHE_DIR, exist_ok=True)
L00053:     print("\nAsserting the groundtruth...")
L00054:     tbegin = time.time()
L00055:     
L00056:     with ProcessPoolExecutor(max_workers=n_workers) as executor:
L00057:         futures = []
L00058:         n_samples = 0
L00059:         expected_time = dict()
L00060:         
L00061:         for problem in problems.values():
L00062:             args = (
L00063:                 problem["complete_prompt"] + "\n" + problem["canonical_solution"],
L00064:                 problem["test"],
L00065:                 problem["task_id"],
L00066:                 max_as_limit,
L00067:                 max_data_limit,
L00068:                 max_stack_limit,
L00069:                 min_time_limit,
L00070:             )
L00071:             
L00072:             futures.append(executor.submit(trusted_check, *args))
L00073:             n_samples += 1
L00074: 
L00075:         for future in tqdm(as_completed(futures), total=n_samples):
L00076:             result = future.result()
L00077:             expected_time[result["task_id"]] = result["time"]
L00078:     
L00079:     print(f"Expected outputs computed in {time.time() - tbegin:.2f}s")
L00080:     
L00081:     if any(expected_time.values()):
L00082:         with open(cache_file, "wb") as f:
L00083:             pickle.dump(expected_time, f)
L00084: 
L00085:     return expected_time

L00087: def check_correctness(
L00088:     completion_id: int,
L00089:     problem: Dict[str, Any],
L00090:     solution: str,
L00091:     max_as_limit: float,
L00092:     max_data_limit: float,
L00093:     max_stack_limit: float,
L00094:     identifier=None,
L00095:     min_time_limit: float = 0.1,
L00096:     gt_time_limit: float = 2.0,
L00097: ) -> Dict[str, Result]:  # {...}, "base" | "plus" -> (status, details)
L00098:     ret = {
L00099:         "completion_id": completion_id,
L00100:         "task_id": problem["task_id"],
L00101:         "_identifier": identifier,
L00102:         "solution": solution,
L00103:     }
L00104:     ret["base"] = untrusted_check(
L00105:         solution,
L00106:         problem["test"],
L00107:         problem["entry_point"],
L00108:         max_as_limit,
L00109:         max_data_limit,
L00110:         max_stack_limit,
L00111:         min_time_limit,

L00117: def evaluate(
L00118:     split: str,
L00119:     subset: str,
L00120:     samples: Optional[str] = None,
L00121:     no_execute: bool = False,
L00122:     execution: str = "gradio", # "e2b", "gradio", "local"
L00123:     selective_evaluate: str = "",
L00124:     e2b_endpoint: str = "bigcodebench_evaluator",
L00125:     gradio_endpoint: str = "https://bigcode-bigcodebench-evaluator.hf.space/",
L00126:     pass_k: str = "1,5,10",
L00127:     save_pass_rate: bool = True,
L00128:     calibrated: bool = True,
L00129:     parallel: int = -1,
L00130:     min_time_limit: float = 1,
L00131:     max_as_limit: int = 30*1024,
L00132:     max_data_limit: int = 30*1024,
L00133:     max_stack_limit: int = 10,
L00134:     check_gt_only: bool = False,
L00135:     no_gt: bool = False,
L00136:     **model_kwargs,
L00137: ):  
L00138:     if not samples and model_kwargs:
L00139:         samples = run_codegen(
L00140:             split=split,
L00141:             subset=subset,
L00142:             **model_kwargs,
L00143:         )
L00144:     
L00145:     if no_execute:
L00146:         return
L00147:     
L00148:     assert samples is not None, "No samples provided"
L00149:         
L00150:     if os.path.isdir(samples):
L00151:         result_path = os.path.join(samples, "eval_results.json")
L00152:     else:
L00153:         assert samples.endswith(".jsonl")
L00154:         result_path = samples.replace(".jsonl", "_eval_results.json")
L00155:     
L00156:     if execution == "gradio":
L00157:         while True:
L00158:             try:
L00159:                 client = Client(gradio_endpoint)
L00160:                 results, pass_at_k = client.predict(
L00161:                     split=split,
L00162:                     subset=subset,
L00163:                     samples=handle_file(samples),
L00164:                     pass_k=pass_k,
L00165:                     parallel=parallel,
L00166:                     min_time_limit=min_time_limit,
L00167:                     max_as_limit=max_as_limit,
L00168:                     max_data_limit=max_data_limit,
L00169:                     max_stack_limit=max_stack_limit,
L00170:                     calibrated=calibrated,
L00171:                     check_gt_only=check_gt_only,
L00172:                     no_gt=no_gt,
L00173:                     selective_evaluate=selective_evaluate,
L00174:                     api_name="/predict"
L00175:                 )
L00176:                 break
L00177:             except (httpx.ReadTimeout, CancelledError):
L00178:                 print("Read timeout error. Retrying in 4s...")
L00179:                 time.sleep(4)
L00180:         gt_pass_rate = pass_at_k["gt_pass_rate"]
L00181:         failed_tasks = pass_at_k["failed_tasks"]
L00182:     
L00183:     elif execution == "e2b":
L00184:         sandbox = Sandbox(e2b_endpoint, api_key=os.environ["E2B_API_KEY"], timeout=60*60)
L00185: 
L00186:         # upload file to sandbox
L00187:         with open(samples, "r") as file:
L00188:             sandbox.files.write(samples, file)
L00189:         
L00190:         # run the evaluation
L00191:         print(f"Command run in sandbox {e2b_endpoint}")
L00192:         command = "bigcodebench.evaluate  --execution 'local' "\
L00193:                         f"--split {split} --subset {subset} --samples {samples} "\
L00194:                         f"--pass_k {pass_k} --save_pass_rate {save_pass_rate} --calibrated {calibrated} "\
L00195:                         f"--parallel {parallel} --selective_evaluate {selective_evaluate} --min_time_limit {min_time_limit} "\
L00196:                         f"--max_as_limit {max_as_limit} --max_data_limit {max_data_limit} --max_stack_limit {max_stack_limit} "
L00197:         
L00198:         if  check_gt_only:
L00199:             command += f"--check_gt_only "
L00200:         if no_gt:
L00201:             command += f"--no_gt "
L00202:         if no_execute:
L00203:             command += f"--no_execute "
L00204:         sandbox.commands.run(command, on_stdout=lambda x: print(x), on_stderr=lambda x: print(x), timeout=60*60)
L00205:         
L00206:         if not check_gt_only:
L00207:             # download the results
L00208:             content = sandbox.files.read(result_path)
L00209:             with open(result_path, "w") as file:
L00210:                 file.write(content)
L00211: 
L00212:     else:
L00213:         
L00214:         pass_at_k = dict()
L00215: 
L00216:         if isinstance(pass_k, str):
L00217:             passk = [int(k) for k in pass_k.split(",") if k.strip()]
L00218:         elif isinstance(pass_k, int):
L00219:             passk = [pass_k]
L00220:         elif isinstance(pass_k, (list, tuple)):
L00221:             passk = list(pass_k)
L00222:         else:
L00223:             raise ValueError(f"Invalid type for pass_k: {type(pass_k)}")
L00224:         
L00225:         if selective_evaluate and isinstance(selective_evaluate, str):
L00226:             selected_ids = set(selective_evaluate.split(","))
L00227:         else:
L00228:             try:
L00229:                 selected_ids = set(selective_evaluate)
L00230:             except:
L00231:                 selected_ids = ""
L00232: 
L00233:         if parallel < 1:
L00234:             n_workers = max(1, multiprocessing.cpu_count() // 2)
L00235:         else:
L00236:             n_workers = parallel

L00238:         if check_gt_only:
L00239:             # bypass the samples
L00240:             samples = "__dummy__.jsonl"
L00241: 
L00242:         problems = get_bigcodebench(subset=subset)
L00243:         
L00244:         # Add selective evaluation logic
L00245:         if selected_ids:
L00246:             problems = {k: v for k, v in problems.items() if k in selected_ids}
L00247:             if not problems:
L00248:                 raise ValueError(f"None of the provided task IDs {selected_ids} were found in the dataset")
L00249: 
L00250:         dataset_hash = get_bigcodebench_hash(subset=subset)
L00251:         
L00252:         if not no_gt:
L00253:             expected_time = get_groundtruth(n_workers, problems, dataset_hash, check_gt_only, max_as_limit, max_data_limit, max_stack_limit, min_time_limit)
L00254:         else:
L00255:             expected_time = {task_id: None for task_id in problems}
L00256:         
L00257:         gt_pass_rate = np.mean([1 if v is not None else 0 for k, v in expected_time.items() if k in problems])
L00258:         failed_tasks = [k for k, v in expected_time.items() if v is None and k in problems]
L00259:         
L00260:         if os.path.isfile(result_path):
L00261:             print(f"Load from previous results from {result_path}")
L00262:             with open(result_path, "r") as f:
L00263:                 results = json.load(f)
L00264: 
L00265:             results = compatible_eval_result(results)
L00266:         else:
L00267:             if check_gt_only:
L00268:             
L00269:                 if gt_pass_rate > 0.99:
L00270:                     cprint(f"Groundtruth pass rate: {gt_pass_rate:.3f}", "green")
L00271:                 else:
L00272:                     cprint(f"Groundtruth pass rate: {gt_pass_rate:.3f}\nPlease be cautious!", "red")
L00273:             
L00274:                 if len(failed_tasks) > 0:
L00275:                     cprint(f"Failed tasks: {failed_tasks}", "red")
L00276:                 
L00277:                 return
L00278:             
L00279:             else:
L00280:                 results = {
L00281:                     "date": datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"),
L00282:                     "eval": {},
L00283:                 }
L00284: 
L00285:                 with ProcessPoolExecutor(max_workers=n_workers) as executor:
L00286:                     futures = []
L00287:                     completion_id = Counter()
L00288:                     n_samples = 0
L00289:                     eval_results = defaultdict(list)  # task_id ->
L00290:                     remainings = set()
L00291: 
L00292:                     print("Reading samples...")
L00293:                     for sample in tqdm(load_solutions(samples)):
L00294:                         task_id = sample["task_id"]
L00295:                         
L00296:                         if task_id not in problems:
L00297:                             # Skip if task is not in problems (either not in dataset or filtered out by selective_evaluate)
L00298:                             continue
L00299:                             
L00300:                         solution = (
